QuestInfo.name: Monstrous Tree Stumpy
QuestInfo.1: Visited Doctor #p1022006# again. He says #o3220000# seems to take all the nutrients from #m102000000#. He also added that if this continues, #m102000000# would become a wasteland devoid of life. The #r#o3220000##k must be eliminated.\n\n#o3220000#  #r#a21461##k
QuestInfo.2: Acting on Doctor #p1022006#'s request, I've tracked down and eliminated #o3220000# that was nourishing on#m102000000#. Will this help #m102000000# return to its original state?

0.0: Welcome. I've been inspecting the #t4031773# you've brought, and I'm confident that my theory is true. However, the problem is that the results are much more serious than we expected.
0.1: I see you're losing me. The #o3220000# wasn't nourishing on the stumps. It has been nourishing on #m102000000#. The stumps weren't being dried up, but instead couldn't find nourishment from the ground itself.
0.2: This is very dreadful situation. If this goes on #m102000000# will become a wasteland. You must help me once again.

yes.0: #o3220000# is a very evil being. It's not only almost invincible, but also dries out the life out of everything else. Getting rid of #r#o3220000##k is the only way to save #m102000000#. Please track down and defeat #o3220000#.

no.0: You still don't understand, do you? This is a matter of life and death! Unbelievable! Coward!

1.0: You're back. How did it go? Oh my, I understand. Try to feel the strength of the ground itself. Then you should feel differently. You have done an honorable deed.

yes.0: However, I'm still feeling uneasy. The #m102000000# has suffered the most. Feels like we'll never get our forest back to its original, healthy state.

mob.0: Sorry, but I have no clue where to find #o3220000#. I apologize that I can't be of much help. Nevertheless, you still need to defeat #r#o3220000##k. You understand, don't you?
